name: Theme Contrast & Button State Visibility Audit
note: The contrast comparison in this gate had never executed. It was guarded by `dist > 30 || backgroundImage.includes(gradient)`, and the button it measures is always a gradient, so white text on a white background passed.

mutations.name: the selected language button is given text the same colour as its background
mutations.why: Text at #4a8bf5 sits 17 units from the gradient stop #3b82f6, under the threshold of 30 — the selected language is then unreadable against its own button. The first attempt used #dbeafe, which is 191 units away and correctly passed: an unfair mutation reported as a gate defect until the numbers were checked.
